title: Automated Inventory Reconciliation Plugin
business: E-commerce logistics teams managing multi-warehouse stock levels.
problem: Manual reconciliation between warehouse management systems and inventory databases causes significant data latency and frequent stock-out errors.
solution: Deploy a custom plugin that bundles an MCP server to connect the inventory database with a skill-based instruction set for automated stock discrepancy reporting.
steps: Define an MCP server to interface with the warehouse database API for real-time stock retrieval.
Create a skill containing reusable instructions for identifying and flagging stock discrepancies.
Package the MCP server and skill into a plugin via the universal plugin directory.
Install the plugin in the ChatGPT workspace and authenticate via the plugin's connection prompt.
Invoke the plugin using the @ symbol in a new chat to trigger the reconciliation workflow.
outcome: Logistics teams gain a unified, automated interface to query stock levels and generate discrepancy reports without manual database exports.
limitation: Plugin hooks are not supported in cloud-orchestrated ChatGPT Work environments, meaning automated background triggers for reconciliation must be handled by the MCP server logic rather than client-side hooks.
